title: Gas Bundle Courtesy on Residential Electricity Supply Rebill Credits
content:
**Rule.** When a Beacon Ridge gas agreement under Residential Natural Gas Supply on the same premise as the corrected Residential Electricity Supply agreement is active on a fixed-rate gas plan, the fixed-bundle rebill courtesy of 5.00 USD is added to the rebill credit; when it is active on a gas plan that is not fixed-rate, the other-bundle rebill courtesy of 3.00 USD is added; when no gas agreement on the premise is active, nothing is added.

| Gas agreement at the premise | Gas plan | Rebill courtesy |
|---|---|---|
| active | fixed-rate | 5.00 USD |
| active | not fixed-rate | 3.00 USD |
| enrollment pending, drop pending or closed | any | nothing |
| none | not applicable | nothing |

**Records read.** The status of the gas agreement recorded at the premise and the rate type of its gas plan. A gas agreement at another of the customer's premises does not count.
